messages:
sam (Docs): opening PR with migration guide and SDK snippet for token rotation. preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/802 — tagging @mina @oliver for cross-team review. CI pending.

mina (Security): thanks. quick scan shows an internal tenant id in the example: `tenant: abc-company-123`. please replace with `tenant: ${TENANT_ID}` and avoid any internal hostnames.

sam (Docs): ah good catch, that slipped in from a draft. will replace tenant value and scrub an internal callback URL `https://internal-ingress.redwood/cb`. what placeholder should we use for URLs?

mina (Security): use `https://example.com/callback` or `https://<HOST>/callback`. also request a secret-scan before merging.

ci-bot: secret-scan started for PR 802 -> completed: findings: 1 literal-looking string `sk-prod-xxxxx` in sdk/example.js line 12.

sam (Docs): ooof. that was a copy-paste from a test fixture. patching now to `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and pushing.

oliver (Legal): heads up: the migration guide references data retention in one paragraph. please add the standard legal blurb about customer data retention and include a link to the policy: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/data-retention. i'll sign off after that.

sam (Docs): added Legal blurb under "Data handling" and updated frontmatter with `sensitive: true` so publishing is gated. also replaced the URL and tenant placeholders. pushed.

ci-bot: ci/docs-preview: failed -> reason: broken link check: /policies/data-retention resolved with 404 in preview environment.

jordan (Platform): tagging infra — preview site doesn't have the policy mirror yet. for docs CI you can point to the intranet canonical URL instead of a relative path. try absolute link to `https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/data-retention`.

sam (Docs): updated the link to the absolute intranet URL. re-running preview.

ci-bot: ci/docs-preview: success -> preview URL https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-802/migration-guide

mina (Security): re-review complete. no secrets detected, placeholders look good, and `sensitive: true` frontmatter is present. approved from Security.

oliver (Legal): approved from Legal :white_check_mark:. left a tiny editorial nit about the phrasing of retention period (DMing @sam).

sam (Docs): thanks both. merging after green CI. aiming for merge at 09:30 PT and will add a follow-up note in #release-plan about gating public publish until the release window.

ci-bot: merge complete: Merge pull request #802 from docs/migration-sdk-rotate -> commit 9f3c2a.

jordan (Platform): noted. Platform will block the public site publish for this page until next Monday release window per `sensitive: true` gating. keep the preview link for audits.

sam (Docs): closing thread — saved preview + approved copy to the docs audit folder. thanks for quick reviews!
